floatingShare.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, our floating rate borrowings totaled $195.0 million, which represented 43.8% of our outstanding debt.

intro.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, our floating rate borrowings totaled $195.0 million, which represented 43.8% of our outstanding debt. As of June 30, 2026, 91.8% of our floating rate debt investments were subject to interest-rate floors that are tied to minimum Prime Rates for purposes of calculating interest due set at 3.25% or higher. Because the Prime Rate as of June 30, 2026 was 6.75%, decreases in interest rates will impact our interest income to a limited extent until the Prime Rate reaches the applicable Prime Rate floor, while increases in interest rates will increase our interest income to the extent that such rates exceed the applicable Prime Rate floor. internallyManaged.sentence: The Company is structured as an externally-managed, closed-end investment company that has elected to be treated as a business development company ("BDC") under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the "1940 Act").
